direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has asked Kasun whether he manages his small food business alone. He gathers his answer.
direction.people: Kasun stands frame right, facing Anudi off screen to the left. He wears a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, with empty hands at his sides. He feels modest but hopeful.

flow.text: Kasun holds his gaze toward Anudi, takes a small breath and lifts his chin slightly.

flow.how: Friendly and modest, answering her curiosity with quiet pride; hope grows in his voice and a restrained smile appears near the end

flow.text: His lips settle and he holds his position, eyes still on Anudi.

direction.camera: Eye-level medium close-up from the road side on a 65mm lens, a steady frame on a tripod with the food three-wheeler soft behind Kasun's right shoulder.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
